# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes the regional distribution of monetary amounts from the transaction records dataset.

## Data Processed
- **Records Analyzed**: 18 records
- **Time Period**: Records R002-R024 from /workspace/data/records.csv
- **Regions Covered**: North, South, West

## Regional Totals
| Region | Total (cents) | Total (USD) |
|--------|---------------|------------|
| North  | 228,137       | $2,281.37  |
| South  | 221,810       | $2,218.10  |
| West   | 297,365       | $2,973.65  |
| **TOTAL** | **747,312** | **$7,473.12** |

## Summary
The West region accounts for the largest share of total transaction amounts at 39.8%, followed by the North region at 30.5% and the South region at 29.7%. All three regions show relatively balanced transaction activity.

## Notes
The input dataset contained 18 records. Records R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, and R021 were not present in the source file.
